minutes_text:
INGLEWOOD  CALIFORNIA

  Library Board
  MINUTES –May 25, 2022

The Inglewood Library Board met on May 25, 2022 via Zoom. The meeting was called to order at 4:34 p.m. by
Board Member Julie Minton.

Roll Call

Present:
  Patt Sanders – At Large Board Member, Chairman
  Julie Minton – District 1 Board Member, Vice Chairman
  Pat Douglas – District 2 Board Member

Absent Board Members:
  Ernesto Castillo – District 3 Board Member
  Jacqueline Cochran – District 4 Board Member

Staff:
  Harjinder Singh – Deputy to the City Manager
  Kerri Arroyo – Library Manager
  Irina Martirosian – Staff Assistant

Public Comments

  None

Approval of the Minutes

  Board Member Sanders made a motion for the approval of the minutes for March 23, 2022.

  All the Board Members approved the minutes.

Board discussion items

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh provided an update on Morningside Park Branch renovation and
  mentioned that the last discussion item will be the furniture plan and will be delivered during the next board meeting.
  Most likely the delivery date of the Morningside Library will be March / April of 2023.

Library Report

  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo gave the board members Library’s update on hiring new librarians, internship,
programming, activities, giveaways, outreach, accomplishments and laptop checkouts,$22,000 Lunch at the Library

  1
 grant, $5,000 Park Pass grant and $1,000 Dea program grant, partnership with crystal stairs, UCLA, West LA
Collage and Parks & Recreation.
  Board member Sanders asked if the Library Newsletter goes out.
  Library Manager Kerri Arroyo stated that every Wednesday the Library Newsletter that markets all our
programs, databases, services, everything that is going on from children’s to teens to adult services goes out to
6,500 library card holders a week in advance.

Friends Report

  Susan Carleo, President of the Friends of Inglewood Public Library (FOIPL) gave an update on the Friends
of Inglewood Public Library organization. She also mentioned having a book sale on July 15 from 11a.m. – 2 p.m.
for friends and family and on July 16 from 10 a.m. – 2 p.m. regular book sale in the depository of the Main Library.

  Board Member Sanders asked what hours are friends at the library?

  President of the FOIPL Susan Carleo answered that friends are at the library on Tuesdays. IF anyone need
to connect with them another day, needs to set up an appointment. If it’s regarding donations, FOIPL has a large
metal donation bin in the lobby of the Main Library that is accessible anytime the library is open. If anyone needs
documentation of the donation for the tax exempt status, FOIPL can send them after.

Public Comments

  None

Commissioner Comments

  Board member Douglas is very happy with the progress that the libraries are proceeding with, impressed
with the percentage of constant contact and stated that it’s a good marketing. Mrs. Douglas also appreciates what
the friends are doing for the library.

  Board Member Minton made a comment about Morningside Library meeting the needs of the public.

  Board Member Sanders talked about recording the library board meetings.

  Deputy to the City Manager Harjinder Singh told the board that the city does not record advisory board
meetings.

  With no further comments the meeting was adjourned at 5:20 p.m.
